newsitem.title: USA: State Bank of India issue priced at premium.
newsitem.headline: State Bank of India issue priced at premium.

text.p: State Bank of India's global offering of 24,735,000 Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) priced at $14.15 per GDR, said underwriter Lehman Brothers on Thursday.
The offering was priced at about a 4.8 percent premium above the underlying share, the underwriter said.
SBI - India's largest bank - had said it plans to use the GDR proceeds to increase exposure in the areas of project and infrastructure finance, and meet growing international banking requirements.
Merrill Lynch was co-managing the deal.
